content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Eastern Coalfields Advisor Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.easterncoalfields.in. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Eastern Coalfields Advisor (MM) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Eastern Coalfields Advisor (MM) recruitment is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Advisor (MM) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Engineering, MBA, PG Diploma, or PG Degree in Business Management/Materials Management, or an equivalent qualification to be eligible for the Advisor (MM) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Advisor (MM) position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 60 years, and the maximum age limit is 65 years for the Advisor (MM) post. No age relaxation is mentioned.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Advisor (MM) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Advisor (MM) post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 100,000 to Rs. 120,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Advisor (MM) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Advisor (MM) position in Eastern Coalfields Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Advisor (MM) post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Advisor (MM) position?
faq.answer: The Advisor (MM) position is a contractual job opportunity.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job is located in Sanctoria, West Bengal, with a pincode of 713333.
